rules.formula: net EST = rate x 0.87 - (diesel/gal / 8.0 mpg + $0.034/mi DEF) x (loaded + empty miles). Diesel is the EIA PADD price plus our pump premium.
rules.per_hour_formula: Hours = (loaded + deadhead) / 50 mph + 2 h load/unload per load.
rules.net_per_mile_formula: Net $/mi EST = net EST / (loaded mi + empty miles).
rules.days_formula: Trip days = (loaded mi + empty miles) / 550 mi/day + 2 h load/unload per load, rounded up to the next half day.
rules.quality_bar: Single load >= $500 net EST, or >= $300 for a same-day run under 250 total miles. A chain needs >= $1,000 total with no losing leg. Length over 40 ft, width over 8.5 ft, or weight over 15,300 lb is an automatic PASS. Cargo up to 12,500 lb is OK; 12,501-15,300 lb is MAYBE (scale check, load centered just ahead of trailer axles). Ram GVWR 14,000 lb binds (CAT empty 10,940 lb on the truck). Step deck (FSD) is a PASS unless the notes allow a flatbed or hotshot. Conestoga (CONG) is a PASS. Notes that say no hot shots are a PASS. Overnight low at the drop of 45 F or below is an automatic PASS (too cold - would idle overnight). If the drop date is beyond the forecast, the climate normal low for that city and month is used and labeled as a normal low. Each load and combo shows a route weather report at 4-6 points along the route. Ice or snow on the route, or gusts of 50+ mph, is a MAYBE and does not PASS by itself.
rules.cold_weather: Overnight low at the drop of 45 F or below is an automatic PASS (too cold - would idle overnight). If the drop date is beyond the forecast, the climate normal low for that city and month is used and labeled as a normal low. The same cutoff applies to any stop on a combo. Each load and combo shows a route weather report (high/low, precip, gusts) at 4-6 points along the route, dated at about 550 mi/day. Ice or snow on the route, or gusts of 50+ mph, is a MAYBE (TAKE becomes MAYBE) and does not PASS by itself.
rules.combo_bar: A 2- or 3-load combo needs >= $1,000 total net EST, must beat the best single load in it by at least $200, and no leg may lose money. Combined weight uses the same 12,500 / 15,300 lb bands. Any combo stop with an overnight low of 45 F or below is an automatic PASS.
